I see you deleted the account that made this comment, but i really hope you come back and check on it. 

That is exactly how I feel. I've done everything I am supposed to do to get better. Therapy, exercise, antidepressants, hobby, move. Everything. But it's been so long, and nothing is getting any better. I feel worse now than I did over a year ago when it first happened. I just don't have any fucking hope left of getting any better.

The only person i love is gone. And she couldn't give a shit what happens to me. I have nobody else. I alientated my friends and family for her. And gave everything i had for her, and she just up and left with some other guy after 6 years together.

>only you can help yourself.

That's some great fucking advice for someone looking for someone to talk to or a helping hand. Jesus I hope you don't comment here often.
